citation: Souza et al. 2024. Sleep Debt and Insulin Resistance: What's Worse, Sleep Deprivation or Sleep Restriction? Sleep Science 17:e272.
protocol: 24 h sleep deprivation vs regular sleep (23:00-07:00); 4 nights of 4 h in bed (01:00-05:00) for sleep restriction; OGTT of 75 g anhydrous glucose in 300 ml with samples at baseline, 30, 60, 90 and 120 min
population: n=28 healthy male subjects, age 18-40 y (two groups: sleep deprivation and sleep restriction)

reports.where: Table 2, OGTT glucose (mg/dL) at 0, 30, 60, 90, 120 min, sleep conditions
Table 2, OGTT insulin (uU/mL) at the same minutes

note: Table 2 is mean +/- SEM (GEE), so the glucose and insulin series at 0-120 min are usable; baseline table 1 is mean +/- SD. Sleep schedule is printed in the abstract and methods.
